name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps visuals crisp, aligning with Manus’ competitive dark theme and Graphify’s interactive graph focus. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode in bright environments, but the toggle keeps flexibility without clutter.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes don’t just bury errors—they hide them entirely when contrast drops below 4.5:1. Light mode’s high contrast solves visibility but ignores the core problem—users still miss critical data when the interface fights glare. The real alternative: a dynamic contrast slider that auto-adjusts per environment, with a one-click preset to match Manus’ dark theme. Settle it with A/B tests measuring error rates in bright vs. dim lighting—no opinions, just data.
